```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# One-page process summary: header, schematic, key facts, levelized cost.
# Same params interface as report_generic.Rmd (built by
# .tech_report_params_generic() in R/report.R); escaping comes from the
# shared package helpers (?energyRt::report_helpers), the rest is local.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.pos = "H")
library(knitr)

is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

html_esc <- function(x) energyRt::report_esc(x, output = "html")
fmt_val <- function(x, digits = 4L) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("--")
  formatC(as.numeric(x), digits = digits, format = "g")
}
comm_list <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0 ||
      !"comm" %in% names(df)) {
    return("")
  }
  paste(unique(as.character(df$comm)), collapse = ", ")
}
```

```{r html_css, results='asis'}
if (is_html) {
  cat("<style>
body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; margin: 20px; }
h1   { font-size: 18px; color: #1f497d; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ert-gray { color: #808080; }
table.kable-table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
table.kable-table th { background: #1f497d; color: white;
  padding: 3px 8px; }
table.kable-table td { padding: 2px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; }
</style>\n")
}
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
if (is_html) {
  cat("<h1>", html_esc(params$name), "</h1>\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(params$desc)) {
    cat("<p class='ert-gray'>", html_esc(params$desc), "</p>\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("# ", params$name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(params$desc)) cat("*", params$desc, "*\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r image, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$image_file) && nzchar(params$image_file %||% "") &&
    file.exists(params$image_file)) {
  cat("![](", gsub("\\\\", "/", params$image_file), "){height=140px}\n\n",
      sep = "")
}
```

```{r schematic, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$draw_file) && file.exists(params$draw_file)) {
  cat("![](", gsub("\\\\", "/", params$draw_file), ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Key facts

```{r facts}
facts <- list(
  c("inputs",        comm_list(params$input_df)),
  c("outputs",       comm_list(params$output_df)),
  c("capacity unit", params$units_cap %||% ""),
  c("activity unit", params$units_act %||% ""),
  c("cost unit",     params$units_costs %||% ""),
  c("cap2act",       fmt_val(params$cap2act)),
  c("olife (years)", fmt_val(params$olife)),
  c("first vintage", fmt_val(params$start)),
  c("last vintage",  fmt_val(params$end)),
  c("stock (total)", fmt_val(params$stock))
)
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(facts, function(z) {
  data.frame(item = z[1], value = z[2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
df <- df[!is.na(df$value) & nzchar(df$value) & df$value != "--", ,
         drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("", ""),
             table.attr = "class='kable-table'",
             format = if (is_html) "html" else "pipe")
```

```{r levcost, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$levcost_npv) && is.finite(params$levcost_npv)) {
  u <- params$units_costs %||% ""
  ua <- params$units_act %||% ""
  cat("\n\n## Levelized cost\n\nNPV LCOE: **",
      fmt_val(params$levcost_npv), "**",
      if (nzchar(u) && nzchar(ua)) paste0(" ", u, "/", ua) else "",
      "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
